valid_scope.scope: supported source, every required Jet-controlled stage, exact candidate identities, all required execution modes, one accepted program, one correctly rejected program

controls.mutation: replace the candidate binary, compiler source, target, configuration, or candidate record identity
remove source, checking, comptime, lowering, optimization, prelude, runtime, adapter, or semantics evidence
replace one stage input/output representation or observation alphabet
replace registered code, reason, source identity, or UTF-8 span
remove the positive supported-program acceptance or mark every mode rejected

unknown_policy: declared controls are not proof; missing, stale, unknown, timeout, wrong, or contradictory evidence remains blocking
